fields.title: Job title
fields.location: City list, else the country list (as published)
fields.countries: All countries on the posting (jobLocation + applicantLocationRequirements)
fields.remote: True when the posting is TELECOMMUTE / described as remote
fields.salary_min: Salary lower bound as a number
fields.salary_max: Salary upper bound as a number
fields.posted_at: Posting date, ISO-8601 (null when the page carries none)
fields.description: Full description as plain text (capped at 40k chars)
fields.apply_url: External apply destination when the page exposes one, else null
fields.card_text: Raw listing-card text (title, company, location, date) as a fallback breadcrumb
